value.rationale: The 2026 complete-spectrum rigidity paper motivates the finite-data inverse problem. This construction shows the exact impossibility of bounding entropy using any finite set of actual embedded periodic cycles even for uniformly expanding, topologically exact continuous interval maps in an arbitrary C0-neighborhood of a fixed tent map. It separates infinitary identifiability from effective finite-data control, a structural boundary that is stronger than bare identical period counts.
